display_name: 响应恢复器故障批次 dense 与低秩后验对照
description: 重复原 E09 源域重放，仅在原残差保护触发时对同一原始和扰动微批比较 dense 与低秩后验。
authorization: Previously authorized source-only technical failure diagnosis; GPU6 one added own process, total at most five.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI, CPU threads 2, FP32/FP64, TF32 off; GPU6 existing<=4 and free>=12000MiB.

data.version: Original R07 epoch10 draw: up to 63000 source rows, L_s6300/U_s56700.
data.representation: Existing paired clean/received IQ2x256 and simulator Action/noise, source receiver metadata and existing global/other-RX priors.
data.physical_ids_ref: Existing source capsule and R07 cache aligned by physical ID and source role.
data.label_map_ref: Unused for scoring. Original F0 default head used only in no-query smoke; continuous source features in numerical objectives.
data.validation_ref: Original source contract and original ResponseJointPrior failed-run E09.
data.support_query_ref: No target U/Q, no V/OE, no TX truth, no target predictions.
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels; original simulated source physical action/noise and frozen F0 continuous feature losses.
data.augmentation: Original saved epoch10 source draw and permutation; no new source synthesis.

permissions.query_use: Up to 63000 L_s/U_s source rows only; no TX truth, V/OE/target inputs or target predictions.
permissions.claim_scope: 同一源微批 low-rank 与 dense 求解残差/IQ 差异；重放轨迹可能不同。没有目标识别或一般数值稳定性结论。

checkpoint.initialization: 原源训练 E09/2223 模型、优化器和 RNG 仅用于临时技术复现；不保存恢复器权重。
sources: Original frozen source Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0 checkpoint and original source global/other-RX moments.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original E09 metadata, configuration, E09/2223, original source-only smoke and saved epoch10 order; original matching F0 and source handles.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original training used only legal source L_s/U_s, simulated action/noise and frozen original F0 continuous features; TX/V/OE/target excluded.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed E09 as last complete technical checkpoint, not source/target model selection; stop on first guard or exception, otherwise one bounded epoch.

execution.gpu_policy: Only GPU6, existing<=4 and free>=12000MiB before one own child, total<=5. Never alter other owners.
execution.stop_rule: 原源域复现保护或异常时停止；在残差保护处比较同一批次两种后验，之后立即结束。最多 247 个临时更新；不保存模型、不重跑目标。

expected_artifacts: dense_comparison.json if residual guard is reproduced

metric_names: 原始及扰动源微批的 low-rank 与 dense 求解残差最大值、超阈记录数和输出 IQ 最大差。
记录首个原始保护条件和临时更新数；无保护重现或 dense 比较失败时如实报告。
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: None; no TX truth or target inputs.

rows.purpose: Determine whether reproduced residual is specific to low-rank arithmetic at the same source inputs and model.
rows.seed_notes: Restores original E09 saved torch RNG, original saved epoch10 permutation and draw10.
rows.optimizer: Original AdamW state restored temporarily, branch clipping unchanged.
rows.budget_ref: Original epoch10 replay, at most247 temporary updates. At first residual guard perform two source-only dense comparisons, then stop; no saved model.
expected_artifacts: dense_comparison.json if residual guard is reproduced

notes: Prior source-only replay reproduced residual 1.15602821049439e-8 >1e-8 with finite loss after 50 updates.
Keep original threshold and numerical training path. Only when the guard triggers compare base and perturbation using the same model, source batch and prior.
Replay may diverge and the original generic error cannot be assigned an exact numerical value.
Eleven targeted tests and independent P0/P1 review PASS; actual E09/F0 source2 smoke is the first step.
